svg.text: Not to scale. Doubler, front and back pulled forward/back; sides, top and bottom pulled out; cleats pulled in. Biscuit slots shown on the visible faces.
Cut all panels from one 2000 × 1000 board (cutting plan in the build guide).
The front sets the box square — check its diagonals.
Ø94 and Ø70 in the front, Ø70 in the doubler, Ø12 and 16 × Ø4.5 in the back.
Two coats of thinned lacquer on all inside faces before assembly — OSB is porous.
Glue to sides, top and bottom, cleat face 23 mm from the rear edge. Jig: back panel
on the rear edges, 22 mm offcuts + 1 mm card underneath as spacers.
30 per cabinet, size 20 (sheet 2). Reference the joiner from the face, not the
fence; check every slot for voids, shift it 20 mm if hollow. No sealer in the slots.
Size the cut edges with thin PVA, let it tack, then glue sides, top and bottom with
biscuits, strap-clamped. A back dry-fitted on wax paper holds it square.
Glue the front on with its 18 biscuits — ratchet strap and cauls across the front.
Flush with the bottom edge, 20 mm in from each side; a Ø70 offcut through both
Glue fillet or acrylic in every inside corner. Tube 151 mm with 20 mm flaps,
butted against the inside of the front, four flaps screwed (3.5 × 12), joint sealed.
Sand 80 then 120 only — the resin-rich chips sand harder than the binder.
Then 2–3 coats of clear water-based lacquer.
Clamp the back on, drill through its holes into the cleats, set the M4 inserts.
Gasket on the cleats, damping, wire driver and terminals, screw the back on.
Aiyima 4″ full-range driver, 8 Ω (plan: Fostex FE103NV2)
sheep's wool fleece ≈ 10 mm + 2 × 50 g polyester fill
PVA glue, clear lacquer, acrylic sealant, wire
The Aiyima 4″ is rated 25 W; the plan's FE103NV2 only 5 W.
Port 175 mm ≈ 48 Hz: bass flat to ≈ 55 Hz (near field), −3 dB at 47 Hz.
With a DSP, set a protective high-pass at ≈ 0.75 × Fb (36 Hz).
Start at a low level — below the port tuning the cone is unloaded.
L'Audiophile no. 29 (1983) · hole positions after R. Berchtold (2022)
22 mm OSB · biscuits (size 20) + wood glue, no screws · removable back
All dimensions in mm · Rev. as built · 13.10.2026
